event: Bank Indonesia holds its November Board of Governors meeting (RDG) on 17-18 November, with the decision due Wednesday 18 November and analysts expecting a 25 bp hike from 5.75% to 6.00%. (update of E0601)
key_numbers: Current BI-Rate 5.75% (held since 18 Jun 2026) · Consensus 6.00% (+25 bp) · RDG 17-18 Nov, decision Wed 18 Nov · Rupiah Rp18,206 on 13 Nov, record intraday low about Rp18,245-18,261 · Permata base case assumes Fed +25 bp in Dec · October inflation 3.23% y/y

event: The IHSG ended the week of 9-13 November up 5.82% at 5,344.41 on surging turnover, with foreign investors net buying for the week even as the rupiah hit record lows. (update of E0798)
key_numbers: IHSG 5,344.41 (from 5,050.42, +5.82%) · Market cap Rp9,047 trillion (from Rp8,744 trillion, +3.47%) · Average daily value Rp23.69 trillion (+114.64% from Rp11.04 trillion) · Foreign net buy for the week about Rp462.73 billion (BEI via Liputan6; Bisnis headline says Rp467.73 billion) vs net sell Rp167.11 billion the week before · Brokers eye 5,400-5,500 resistance if 5,300 holds

event: The rupiah ended the week at Rp18,206 per US dollar, weaker 0.65% on the week, after touching a record intraday low on 12 November; BI intervened in NDF, DNDF, spot and bond markets. (update of E0800)
key_numbers: Close 13 Nov Rp18,206 (Bloomberg) vs Rp18,089 a week earlier (-0.65%) · JISDOR Rp18,218 vs Rp18,130 · 12 Nov intraday Rp18,261, close Rp18,239 · CORE forecast range Rp18,100-18,250 next week · Resistance Rp18,245-18,270 (Vibiznews)

event: The US Federal Reserve releases minutes of its 28 October meeting on 18 November, while markets fully price a 25 bp hike at the 9 December FOMC after hot US October CPI and Governor Waller's hawkish remarks. (update of E0771)
key_numbers: Fed funds held at 3.75-4.00% on 28 Oct, with Cook and Hammack dissenting for a hike · FOMC minutes Wed 18 Nov · 25 bp hike fully priced for 9 Dec, about 10% odds of 50 bp · Bank of America sees hikes in Dec, Jan and Mar · US October retail sales Tue 17 Nov (consensus +0.2% m/m) · US October CPI +0.4% m/m

event: The MPR scheduled a plenary session on 2 December 2026 to elect and inaugurate a new Vice President after Gibran's resignation, with Prabowo asked to nominate candidates, and the Finance Ministry warned political turmoil could affect Indonesia's rating. (update of E0770)
key_numbers: MPR plenary 2 Dec 2026 · Prabowo reportedly asked to send two names in the week of 16 Nov (single minor outlet, unverified) · Foreign analyst call of up to 7% IHSG drop did not materialise (IHSG +5.82% on the week)

event: BEI said eight companies are in its IPO pipeline as of 13 November 2026, mostly mid-sized, down from nine reported earlier in the month. (update of E0662)
key_numbers: 8 companies queuing as of 13 Nov vs 9 earlier · Mostly mid-size assets · No listing dates for 16-22 Nov found

event: President Prabowo, after attending Muhammadiyah's Tanwir in Palu, arrived in Manila for the 49th ASEAN Summit (15-17 Nov) and is to continue to the APEC summit in China, and he will name his two vice-presidential candidates only after the trips. (update of E0805)
key_numbers: ASEAN Summit 15-17 Nov 2026 (Manila) · APEC summit in China next, date not confirmed · MPR plenary 2 Dec 2026

event: Wed 18 Nov is the latest date for President Prabowo to hand MPR leadership two vice-presidential candidate names, since the MPR rules require submission at least 14 days before the 2 Dec plenary; MPR chair Muzani said 'insyaallah' the names arrive next week. (update of E0805)
key_numbers: Deadline about 18 Nov 2026 · 2 names · at least 14 days before the plenary (Peraturan MPR 1/2024, Art. 136(1) per Okezone) · plenary Wed 2 Dec 2026 · Prabowo told parties to discuss proposals within about 1 week

event: Parties floated names for the vacant vice presidency: PAN's Zulkifli Hasan proposed a Gerindra cadre, Golkar said Puan and Bahlil are in the running while it awaits its own deliberation, and DPD figures raised Sultan Najamuddin and Sri Sultan HB X; the Palace has named no one. (update of E0807)
key_numbers: 2 candidates to be proposed · Golkar names: Puan Maharani, Bahlil Lahadalia · DPD alternatives: Sultan Najamuddin, Sultan HB X · Demokrat (AHY) said earlier it will not submit a name

event: Paspampres said Gibran keeps protective escort after leaving office, with the detail shifting to Grup D, and photos of him began to be taken down in government buildings. (update of E0821)
key_numbers: Escort moved to Paspampres Grup D · resignation effective 12 Nov 2026

event: The Jakarta Tipikor court rejected ex-Deputy Minister Silmy Karim's objection (putusan sela) on 12 Nov, so his gratification and extortion trial over residence permits for foreigners continues with prosecution witnesses on Tue 17 Nov. (update of E0713)
key_numbers: Putusan sela 12 Nov 2026 · next hearing Tue 17 Nov 2026 (witnesses) · case 81/Pid.Sus-TPK/2026/PN Jkt.Pst · charges: gratifikasi and pemerasan on izin tinggal terbatas

event: DPR Komisi III formed a working committee (Panja) chaired by Habiburokhman to finish the Asset Forfeiture Bill (RUU Perampasan Aset), targeting passage by 15 Dec 2026 and holding public hearings during recess.
key_numbers: Target passage by 15 Dec 2026 · 35 RDPU and 3 regional visits (DPR) · DPR Masa Persidangan II runs 10 Nov to 17 Dec 2026

event: Komnas HAM asked UGM for CCTV footage of the 10 Nov demonstration, while a Surabaya citizens' coalition criticised alleged violence by officers against protesters in Yogyakarta.
key_numbers: Demonstration 10 Nov 2026 (Yogyakarta/UGM)

key_numbers: Location: rumah dinas Bupati Kupang

key_numbers: Earnings date 17 Nov 2026 · call 5:00 pm ET (about 04:00 WITA 18 Nov) · quarter ended 25 Oct 2026 · interim CEO Colette Kress

event: BNI will begin closing BNI Mobile Banking in stages from 30 November 2026, pushing customers to the newer app; this is the countdown week-ahead reminder. (update of E0758)
key_numbers: Closure starts 30 Nov 2026 · 15 days left from 15 Nov

event: Harbolnas 2026 is scheduled for 10-16 December with a government transaction target of Rp40 trillion, up from Rp36.4 trillion last year (outside the 16-22 Nov window, but the Road to Harbolnas campaign is under way).
key_numbers: 10-16 Dec 2026 · target Rp40 trillion · 2025 Rp36.4 trillion · 14th edition

event: Menko Polkam Dudung Abdurachman said 15 personnel have died in 2026 fighting forest and land fires, after a Mi-17V5 helicopter crash in Seruyan on 4 Nov (3 TNI AD) and a Super Puma falling into the Barito River on 8 Nov. (update of E0823)
key_numbers: 15 personnel dead in 2026 · 3 TNI AD killed 4 Nov (Seruyan, Central Kalimantan) · 1 killed 8 Nov (Barito Kuala, South Kalimantan)
